Welcome to 841 Fountain Dr, a premier modern single-story pool home located on FEE SIMPLE LAND YOU OWN in the guard-gated eco-friendly community of Miralon Palm Springs. Built in 2022, this bright 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence spans 2,084 sq ft on an oversized 6,970 sq ft lot featuring exceptional privacy with no immediate neighbor on one side due to an expansive landscaped common area buffer. Perfectly oriented to showcase south-facing, unobstructed San Jacinto Mountain views with no visible power lines, the light-filled open floor plan features soaring high ceilings, clerestory windows, and a chef's kitchen complete with an oversized waterfall-edge island and gas range. Enjoy thoughtful floor plan separation with the primary suite situated on one side of the home and two guest bedrooms on the opposite side. Every bedroom features a private ensuite bath, highlighted by a spacious primary suite with a dual-sink vanity and spa-like shower. Step outside to enjoy two distinct outdoor living zones, including a private side-yard swimming pool plus a massive, separate south-facing backyard directly off the living room designed for lounging, BBQing, and enjoying the custom putting green framed by dramatic mountain views. The property also features low-maintenance artificial turf, low-water desert landscaping, a solar system (to be paid off in full by seller at close of escrow upon full price offer, providing buyer with an owned system $20,000+ value offering immediate monthly utility savings), an EV charger, a 2-car garage, and a dedicated laundry room. Designed for active wellness, Miralon's master-planned agrihood lifestyle features over 7 miles of walking trails, direct adjacency to the regional 40-mile CV Link biking pathway, olive groves, parks, and a clubhouse retreat with resort pools, spa, cabanas, fitness/yoga studio, bocce courts, and a Wi-Fi lounge. Enjoy short-term rental potential with a 7-day minimum per city/HOA rules, all just minutes from Downtown Palm Springs, the Uptown Design District, and Palm Springs International Airport (PSP). FURNITURE AND FURNISHINGS ARE AVAILABLE OUTSIDE OF ESCROW.

results.remarks: Discover this classic 1938 Palm Springs cottage, flawlessly updated for today's desert living. By opening up the living space, this home provides a comfortable entertaining environment along with two bedrooms and two baths. You'll enjoy the variety of gorgeous tile selections throughout, and curated color palettes that elevate the home's style while maintaining the fun, carefree feel of desert living. From the central gas fireplace that anchors the living room, to the multiple access points to the backyard, this home is flawless.The living room has two doors leading to a covered outdoor living room that acts as the hinge between the interior and the backyard. This mirroring of the living space extends the livable area outside to enjoy the pool, spa, and large backyard with mountain views. The backyard also has generous space along the south side, which has the potential for RV parking or possibly the future location of an ADU.From the kitchen -- with its full suite of newer appliances, walnut cabinets, and quartz counters with a waterfall edge at the dine-in prep island -- to the spectacular bathroom finishes, nothing has been overlooked. The large primary suite has backyard access as well as an en-suite bath with a double vanity, while the guest bath includes a shower and tub so that any level of spa experience can be achieved.The updates aren't only skin deep: an updated electrical panel and wiring, a stackable washer/dryer in the laundry room off the kitchen, a pool system with remote control, plumbing updates, and many more. The home also operates as an active short-term rental and meets all code compliance necessary to do so. Nothing has been overlooked.ADDITIONAL ITEMS AND AMENITIES  Full update of the kitchen and both baths, include cabinets, finishes, fixtures, plumbing, and appliances.  Backyard pool and spa is newer with remote pool access for equipment  Professional landscaping includes artificial turf mixed with a repeating geometric decking pattern creating both ample front parking space and an enjoyable entertaining backyard.

results.remarks:
Tucked behind the gates of Mountain Gate, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath Alta Mira sells the Palm Springs resort lifestyle from the moment you walk in.
The entry hall makes a statement with decorative tile inlays and crown molding that carries throughout the home. From there, the open great room flows past a gas fireplace into a beautifully updated kitchen — but the real showstopper is the pair of French glass door sets framing your private backyard, pool, and unobstructed mountain views.

This kitchen wasn't built for reheating takeout. Slab granite counters, a gas range, stainless appliances, a large pantry, and an oversized island made for gathering — this is where the party ends up every time.

The primary suite is its own private wing, with room for a sitting area or home office, a remodeled walk-in shower, dual vanities, and a walk-in closet that actually fits everything. Bedrooms two and three share a remodeled second bath on the opposite side of the home — perfect for guests, family, or both.

The details that make daily life easier: a dedicated inside laundry room, direct-access two-car garage, and gated RV parking — a rare find on this lot.
Step outside to your own private oasis: an in-ground pool and spa, plus an electric awning for the extra-sunny afternoons when you want a little more shade. It's the backyard that makes people fall for desert living in the first place.

And the community keeps delivering — tennis and basketball courts, a covered BBQ area, a playground, three community pools and spas, and roaming security patrol. All just minutes from Palm Canyon Drive, the Aerial Tramway, and everything downtown Palm Springs has to offer.

Mountain views included. Move-in ready. This is the one.

results.remarks: Architectural sophistication meets effortless Palm Springs living in this extensively reimagined residence within the gated community of Tierra Hermosa. Following an extraordinary $300,000+ renovation, every space has been thoughtfully curated with custom finishes, premium materials, and designer details, creating a home that is as functional as it is visually striking. The dramatic, western-facing great room is filled with natural light beneath soaring two-story ceilings and frames stunning mountain views and sunsets, while sealed concrete floors, sculptural lighting, rounded architectural details, and an open-concept floor plan establish a refined contemporary aesthetic. The chef's kitchen is a true centerpiece, featuring custom cabinetry by Kerf, quartz countertops, a Fireclay farmhouse sink, Fisher & Paykel integrated refrigerator, Cafe' double-convection gas range, Miele integrated dishwasher, and designer backsplash. The primary bathroom is a showpiece with coved ceilings, a wet room with a freestanding soaking tub, and Phylrich fixtures throughout. No detail was overlooked behind the walls, including a Trane XR17 two-stage HVAC system with Lennox PureAir whole-house filtration, a Nest Pro smart thermostat, a Bradford White water heater, Sonos whole-home audio with built-in Sonance speakers, a new garage door opener, and smart Jandy iAquaLink pool controls. The private outdoor retreat is equally inviting with a sparkling pool and spa, upgraded landscaping, artificial turf, low-voltage lighting, French drains, custom planters, mechanical awning with Sunbrella fabric, and multiple spaces for entertaining or relaxing beneath the desert sky. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, restaurants, shopping, entertainment, golf, and hiking, this exceptional home offers a rare opportunity to own one of Tierra Hermosa's only comprehensively renovated residences, where timeless architecture, exceptional craftsmanship, and modern luxury come together in perfect harmony.

results.remarks: Experience luxury desert living at its finest with this fully updated and stylish 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering a resort-style backyard and beautiful mountain views. Situated on a generous corner lot, this immaculate property is perfect for both entertaining and relaxing in true Palm Springs style.From the moment you enter, modern design and comfort greet you. Updated windows and doors fill the home with natural light while showcasing the gleaming tile flooring, designer color palettes, and surrounding mountain scenery. The flexible layout includes a spacious living area and a secondary sitting area ideal for lounging or reading.The open kitchen features light wood cabinetry, a full suite of stainless-steel appliances, a sleek tile backsplash, and a dining counter with a waterfall edge. Adjacent to the kitchen is a welcoming space with a fireplace currently serving as the dining area, which is ideal for gatherings and conversation. From here, sliding glass doors connect the interior to a private resort-inspired backyard complete with a sparkling pool, raised spa, and multiple seating areas. Several lounging zones feature low-maintenance artificial turf and there is a cozy gas firepit for evening enjoyment. A stylish dining pergola with bistro string lighting adds a touch of romance to outdoor entertaining.The primary suite opens directly to the backyard and offers a tranquil retreat with mountain views, ample closet space, and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom. Two additional bedrooms are located at the front of the home with bright eastern exposure, accompanied by a designer hall bath featuring modern tile and fixtures.Additionally, there is an attached two-car garage with stacked laundry. The side yard provides RV parking in case your Airstream needs a home. For buyers seeking economic flexibility, this property qualifies for a junior rental permit through the City of Palm Springs, allowing up to six short-term rentals annually and unlimited stays of 30 days or longer--making it a perfect option for those wishing to offset living expenses with rental income.

results.remarks: Sandcliff. Palm Springs. Private. Historic.  It does not get more iconic than this. Set on 5 acres in south Palm Springs, the 40-units of Sandcliff were among the first to be zoned for medium density development in Palm Springs and on fee (you own) land. Developed by the Berkeley Square Company and designed by Sherwin L. Barton, Sandcliff is a superb example of Desert Modern architecture and the 'lifestyle condominium' complexes that became so popular throughout Palm Springs in the 1960s. Originally designed as a 3 BR (third bedroom currently shown as a den with closet) with 2 BA, the unit totals 1769 interior sq ft, with in-unit laundry.  There are three generous patios with mountain views which adds to the luxury indoor/outdoor living and much of the original cabinetry remains in place in the kitchen and baths. Located in a very private location within the development. The light filled living room is generous in size and has views to the front courtyard entry patio. A second patio is off the dining area with southern mountain views. The den and two other bedrooms all have sliders to a third, large main patio which has western mountain views, perfect for dining and lounging with the two community pools nearby.   The carport for the home is immediately adjacent with storage. Sandcliff has remained remarkably intact since the completion of its construction in 1964. As a result, on February 3rd, 2016, the development received the historical designation of Historic District #5 by the City of Palm Springs and can now benefit from the Mills Act. The current owner has completed the application and submitted for Mills Act status. At the time of this listing, the application is still in review. This home is what Palm Springs Modern should be.

results.remarks: Sophisticated coastal charm meets Hugh Kaptur's desert modern design in this Desert Dorado home in the Oasis Del Sol neighborhood of Palm Springs. Tucked away at the end of a cul-de-sac with a majestic ocotillo in front, this home boasts a 3 bedroom main house and casita tucked behind its 2 car garage. The home was recently updated by its owners with alluring gold hardware details and luxe kitchen counter surfaces, and updated appliances. 566 Sunset features a living and dining room with a vaulted ceiling anchored by a gas fireplace. The updated kitchen opens to an atrium enclosed solarium that looks out to a spacious yard and turquoise classic kidney-shaped pool. Stunning views to the San Jacinto mountains take center stage, from any point in the yard, loungers by the pool or the conversational seating area that surrounds the fire pit. The house features two guest bedrooms and a primary suite with extra deep closets and a sliding door out to the yard and pool. The en-suite bathroom includes a long vanity with dual sinks and a shower tub combo. The hall /guest bath features a shower/tub combo as well. The Two car garage house the washer and drier and gas water heater. A fourth bedroom/casita with its own separate entrance and private courtyard that was added by the original owners has its own en-suite bathroom with shower that could be rented separately or used as a guest room or office. The room opens out to the back yard with a sliding door as well. The HVAC system has a gas heater and provides central air conditioning. Owned solar with two Tesla Power walls has been added on the roof (composite and clay tile.)  Come see this wonderfully updated home and its big back yard with fantastic views. (Chandelier in dining does not convey)

results.remarks: PRIME MIRALON RETREAT IN PALM SPRINGS. Designed for effortless desert living, this fully furnished, beautifully appointed, private pool home showcases an open-concept floor plan enhanced by bespoke finishes including a striking accent wall that offers modern sophistication to the main living space. Towering ceilings, expansive windows and sliding glass doors flood the interior with natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance throughout. The chef’s kitchen impresses with white quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, white cabinetry, and generous island perfect for casual dining, meal prep and gatherings. Seamless flow between the kitchen and living areas makes the space ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is thoughtfully designed for comfort and relaxation. The spa-inspired bathroom features dual sinks, contemporary finishes and curbless walk-in shower, offering a resort-like experience. Additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, or home office. Indoor-outdoor living is at the forefront of this home’s design. Enjoy your own private oasis, where a sparkling spool invites you to cool off under the desert sun. Multiple patio areas offer options for dining, lounging, and entertaining, while the low-maintenance artificial turf adds year-round greenery. All of this set against breathtaking southern mountain views, delivering a serene and picturesque backdrop. Owned solar and short term rentals allowed (city regulations). Minutes from downtown Palm Springs, this home offers convenient access to vibrant dining, shopping, galleries and entertainment. Enjoy the best of desert living with close proximity to renowned restaurants, boutique shops and lively energy that makes Palm Springs a world-class destination. Residents enjoy a thoughtfully designed, amenity-rich environment that embraces both wellness and connection. The gated community offers miles of meandering walking and biking trails, 7000 olive trees, u-pick gardens, lakes, dog parks, and gathering areas that encourage an active, social lifestyle. Abundant resort-style amenities, including pools w/cabanas, spas, Yoga studio, fitness/wellness center, conference rooms and stylish Miralon Club with Mirabar designed for relaxation and community events. Other amenities include bocce ball, firepits and outdoor BBQ areas. With modern design, natural desert surroundings and strong sense of community. Experience a masterpiece of extraordinary luxury living and lifestyle

results.remarks: One of the most unique and affordable opportunities on an expansive 18,295 sq. ft. lot in the prestigious Indian Canyons neighborhood of South Palm Springs. Once owned by Fey's Canyon and long been said to have originally served as a William Krisel and Dan Palmer designed "clubhouse" for Canyon View Estates, this updated single family home with NO HOA is a captivating expression of Mid Century architecture and Palm Springs living. Enter into a dramatic great room crowned by an 8 beamed "Umbrella" ceiling and clerestory windows that flood the space with natural light and create an unforgettable architectural statement. The expansive living area offers exceptional flexibility for multiple seating arrangements and entertaining spaces, anchored by a stunning painted wall mural that adds warmth and artistic character. The primary suite enjoys beautiful mountain views, a large walk in closet, and an attached bath, while the guest bath features an oversized walk in shower with a picture window framing the surrounding hillside. The spacious updated kitchen and dining area showcases charming "peek a boo" windows overlooking the landscape along with generous counter space and abundant cabinetry. Outside, the breathtaking backyard becomes a private sanctuary tucked against the hillside with dramatic mountain views and a palm tree lined landscape stretching into the distance. Lounge beside the sparkling pool and spa, gather under the shaded gazebo, or enjoy evenings around the festive gas firepit. The setting is serene, magical, and quintessentially Palm Springs. The property offers remarkable versatility and may be enjoyed immediately as a full time residence, seasonal retreat, or successful vacation rental, as it has been in recent years. Yet perhaps even more exciting is the extraordinary future potential. Surrounded by multi-million dollar estates, this property presents a rare opportunity to create a truly spectacular gated luxury compound or reimagined architectural estate. The scale of the lot, the setting against the hillside, and the prestigious surrounding homes create tremendous upside for a buyer with vision. Additional highlights include a renewed land lease through 2080, 32 seller-owned solar panels, and a 10kWh battery system. There is simply nothing else like this in Indian Canyons. A rare architectural gem that offers charm, flexibility, income potential, and exceptional long term value in one of Palm Springs' most sought after neighborhoods. Sold completely turn-key.

results.remarks: Hidden Gem of Palm Springs: A Mid-Century Modernist's Dream: Vaulting mountains surround our beautiful valley. The Santa Rosas to the southwest, San Jacinto to our west, and the Little San Bernardinos to the north form a living movie screen where light and shadow dance throughout the day.  In a valley dominated by flat landscapes and ubiquitous 'patio homes,' 2696 S. Sierra Madre (Unit F14) offers a rare, bird's-eye perspective. Distance through glass becomes your artwork, and privacy is a given -- all wrapped in a clean, contemporary envelope.The Pedigree: Twin Springs by Don Wexler: Designed amidst a park-like setting with streams, bridges, pools, and ball courts by famed mid-century architect Don Wexler, Twin Springs is an 'it' development few even know exists. So unique, it was featured in Modernism Week under the title 'Hidden Gem.' While Wexler's Sagewood features single-story layouts and The Rose Garden offers classic townhouses, Twin Springs stands out with a bold, multi-level architectural design that feels as fresh today as it did when built in 1973.Modern Luxury & Intentional Updates: Unit F14 has been thoroughly reimagined to exceed the demands of today's lifestyle, offering sophisticated improvements over the original design, including:  * Chef's Kitchen: A modern, open-concept kitchen seamlessly integrates the dining and living areas in a clean, white palette. Features a state-of-the-art suite of appliances, including an induction stove, dedicated wine storage, and a pantry.  * Smart Spaces: A built-in workstation is neatly tucked into an alcove for effortless remote work, complemented by the must-have convenience of hidden, in-unit laundry. * The View Balcony: Step out onto the long, wide balcony to overlook enchanting grounds, the iconic geometric pool, the rising San Jacinto range, and the endless desert sky.Twin Springs offers an unparalleled, resort-style community with amenities featuring: * A one-of-a-kind geometric pool composed of hexagonal segments + a second pool * Two relaxing spas * Tennis & pickleball courts * A clubhouse complete with dry saunas in both the men's and women's restroomsWhy just visit paradise when you can live here?   ***Schedule your private viewing of this architectural masterpiece today!***

Don't miss your opportunity to own one of Palm Springs' most iconic architectural designs before the fall season begins.
